
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20065217" title="发布于 2026-05-17 20:24">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript如何实现LINQ语法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="DFLfMTFQ" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>AScript是一个开源的C<a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1" data-recommend="">#动态脚本解析执行引擎</a>，支持扩展自定义语法，本篇将详细讲解如何扩展实现LINQ语法。</span></p>
<h2 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>一、原理</span></h2>
<p data-pid="8IzmvEne"><span>LINQ语句会被编译为调用<span>Queryable/Enumerable<span>扩展方法中的<span>SelectMany/Where/Join/GroupJoin/GroupBy/OrderBy/OrderByDescending/Select<span>等方法。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-pid="b8nv55LK"><span>Queryable/Enumerable<span>扩展方法已通过<code><span>AddFunc</span></code><span>方式注入到了<code><span>CSharpLang</span></code><span>语言中：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> IEnumerable&lt;T&gt;扩展方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(System.Linq.Enumerable));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> IQueryable&lt;T&gt;扩展方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(System.Linq.Queryable));</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="3Rjdzizo" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>LINQ To SQL通过分析Queryable扩展方法及Lambda参数生成对应的SQL语句来执行数据库查询操作。</span></p>
<p data-pid="o-QsCnEo"><span>我们只要实现从LINQ语句生成调用<span>Queryable/Enumerable<span>扩展方法即可。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>二、示例</span></h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestSqliteContext())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = from p in context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    join a in context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId into aa
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    from a in aa.DefaultIfEmpty()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    select new { p.Id, p.Name, p.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(list, Formatting.Indented));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>生成的sqlite查询语句为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> "p"."Id", "p"."Name", "p"."Age", "a"."Address" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "MyAddress"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> "Persons" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "p"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">LEFT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> "AddressInfos" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "a" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> "p"."Id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> "a"."UserId"</pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">下面我们来看看如何实现LINQ语法。</span></p>
<h2 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>三、定义QueryNode节点</span></h2>
<p data-pid="s7hvpLA5"><span>首先，定义一个LINQ查询语法树节点，用于管理LINQ语法中的from/where/join/group/orderby/select语句，并在执行或编译时生成对应的方法调用。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QueryNode : TreeNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 变量所属上级（变量聚合）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; _VarParentDict = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 变量所属上级计数（变量聚合计数）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> _ParentCounter = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前变量名</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前数据源</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ITreeNode _Source;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression Build(BuildContext buildContext, ScriptContext scriptContext, BuildOptions options)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _Source.Build(buildContext, scriptContext, options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(ScriptContext context, BuildOptions options, EvalControl control, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Type returnType)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> _Source.Eval(context, options, control, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> returnType);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1、添加from语句</span></h3>
<p data-pid="-cEckbEw"><span>在<span>QueryNode<span>中添加<span>AddFrom<span>方法，增加LINQ中的from语句：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from varName in source
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AddFrom(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> varName, ITreeNode source)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Source == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第1个from语句</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         _Source =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> source;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         _CurrentVarName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> varName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> _Source.SelectMany(_CurrentVarName =&gt; source, (_CurrentVarName, varName) =&gt; new { _CurrentVarName, varName })</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> selectMany = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallFuncNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SelectMany</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ITreeNode[]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            _Source,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName =&gt; source</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineFuncNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>                 Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineVarNode(_CurrentVarName) },
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>                 Body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TryVisitAndReplace(source)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            },
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> (_CurrentVarName, varName) =&gt; new { _CurrentVarName, varName }</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineFuncNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>                 Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineVarNode(_CurrentVarName) },
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineVarNode(varName) }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                },
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span>                 Body = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NewNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span>                     InitProperties = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ITreeNode[]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span>                         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VariableNode(_CurrentVarName),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span>                         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VariableNode(varName)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新当前数据源</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span>     _Source =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> selectMany;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 变量聚合</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> oldCurrentName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span>     _CurrentVarName = $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier{_ParentCounter++}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span>     _VarParentDict[oldCurrentName] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">51</span>     _VarParentDict[varName] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">52</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="uZPksrJZ" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>多个from语句生成<code><span>SelectMany</span></code><span>方法调用，方法调用对应的是<code><span>CallFuncNode</span></code><span>节点，Lambda参数或者Func&lt;&gt;参数对应的是<code><span>DefineFuncNode</span></code><span>节点。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-pid="0KYjtEaZ"><span>SelectMany方法第2个参数为变量聚合，所以我们需要生成聚合变量名并跟踪当前变量聚合路径，<code><span>TryVisitAndReplace</span></code><span>方法用于替换数据源中的变量聚合路径，这里不作说明，详情可查看<code><span>QueryNode</span></code><span>源码。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>2、添加where语句</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from a in query1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from b in query2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> where a.Age == b.Age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AddWhere(ITreeNode condition)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Source == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exceptions.ScriptAnalyzingException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">invalid expression where</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> _Source.Where(&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0 =&gt; (&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.a.Age == &lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.b.Age))</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> whereNode = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallFuncNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Where</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ITreeNode[]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> &lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0 =&gt; (&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.a.Age == &lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.b.Age)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineFuncNode

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>                 Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefineVarNode(_CurrentVarName) },
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>                 Body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TryVisitAndReplace(condition)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新当前数据源</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>     _Source =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> whereNode;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="RyVpHMLg" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>where语句生成<code><span>Where</span></code><span>方法调用，<code><span>&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0</span></code><span>为聚合参数，<code><span>a</span></code><span>和<code><span>b</span></code><span>是where语句中的参数，<code><span>TryVisitAndReplace</span></code><span>方法就是把where语句中的<code><span>a、b</span></code><span>参数替换为聚合参数路径：<code><span>&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.a</span></code><span>和<code><span>&lt;&gt;h__TransparentIdentifier0.b</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>3、添加select语句</span></h3>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>

<p data-pid="pAwpxjJG" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>select语句表示一个查询语句的结束，所以要重置变量，后续查询时重新跟踪变量。</span></p>
<h3 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>4、添加join语句</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AddJoin(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> varName, ITreeNode source, ITreeNode key1, ITreeNode key2, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> intoName = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Source == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exceptions.ScriptAnalyzingException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">invalid expression join</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrEmpty(intoName))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        AddJoin1(varName, source, key1, key2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> }</pre>

<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>join语句分<code><span>inner join</span></code><span>和<code><span>left join</span></code><span>两种语法：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><code data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>inner join</span></code><span>对应<code><span>Join</span></code><span>方法</span></span></span></li>

<div class="cnblogs_code">

<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><code data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>left join</span></code><span>对应<code><span>GroupJoin</span></code><span>方法，后续紧跟着from语句对应<code><span>SelectMany</span></code><span>及<code><span>DefaultIfEmpty</span></code><span>方法</span></span></span></span></span></li>

<p data-pid="nZx_GqO8" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><code><span>left join</span></code><span>语句我们不需要跟踪<code><span>varName</span></code><span>变量，而是跟踪<code><span>intoName</span></code><span>变量。</span></span></span></p>

<p data-pid="DBbNd28-" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>跟select语句类似，group语句也要重置变量，后续语句重新从group数据源查询并跟踪变量。</span></p>
<h3 data-into-catalog-status=""><span>6、添加orderby语句</span></h3>
<p data-pid="LAnvz0ZP"><span>orderby语句有2种排序模式：<code><span>ascending</span></code><span>和<code><span>descending</span></code><span>，默认为<code><span>ascending</span></code><span>，AScript脚本支持简化<code><span>asc</span></code><span>和<code><span>desc</span></code><span>&nbsp;。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> orderby a.Age descending
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AddOrderby(ITreeNode key, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mode)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Source == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> _Source.OrderByDescending(a =&gt; a.Age)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">orderby</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallFuncNode

<h2 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>四、定义LINQ语法解析</span></h2>
<p data-pid="TZbnCfky"><span>LINQ语法是from语句开头，select或group语句结尾，AScript脚本对结尾语句不做约束。</span></p>
<p data-pid="GBlVdUPP"><span>我们创建<code><span>FromTokenHandler</span></code><span>类，用于解析LINQ语句。</span></span></p>
<p data-pid="-r8TgtwQ"><span>并在CSharpLang中注册解析器：<code><span>AddTokenHandler("from", FromTokenHandler.Instance)</span></code><span>&nbsp;。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from a in query1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from b in query2

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">60</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">61</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">62</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exceptions.ScriptAnalyzingException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">invalid expression near from, unknow {token.Value.Value} at ({token.Value.Line},{token.Value.Column})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">63</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">64</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">65</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将LINQ语句添加到语法树中</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">66</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">67</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">68</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TreeBuilder.AddData(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">69</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">70</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">71</span> }</pre>
</div>

<h3 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5、解析group语句</span></h3>
<p data-pid="TTl0-l4H"><span>标准LINQ语法中，group后面必需写element，即：<code><span>group a by a.Age</span></code><span>，在AScript脚本中可以简化不写element：<code><span>group by a.Age</span></code><span>&nbsp;。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from a in q1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> group a.Name by a.Age into g
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildGroup(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e, BuildOptions createFullOptions, QueryNode queryNode)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> element =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _ByTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">by</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _JoinEndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> intoName = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> intoToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.TokenReader.Read();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (intoToken.HasValue)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (intoToken.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">into</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> intoNameToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, ETokenType.Word);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>             intoName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> intoNameToken.Value.Value;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>     queryNode?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.AddGroup(key, element, intoName);

<h3 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>6、解析orderby语句</span></h3>
<p data-pid="kt8J_fAw"><span>增加了<code><span>asc/desc</span></code><span>关键字来简化<code><span>ascending/descending</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from a in q
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> orderby a.Age ascending
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildOrderby(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e, BuildOptions createFullOptions, QueryNode queryNode)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _OrderbyEndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.TokenReader.Read();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> mode = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (token.HasValue)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ascending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) || token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">asc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) || token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">descending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) || token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">desc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>             mode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token.Value.Value;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TokenReader.Push(token.Value);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>     queryNode?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.AddOrderby(key, mode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h2 data-into-catalog-status="" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>五、总结</span></h2>
<p data-pid="xpIwCrY3"><span>我们通过自定义<span>QueryNode<span>和<span>FromTokenHandler<span>，扩展实现了LINQ语法，支持<span>LINQ to Object<span>和<span>LINQ to SQL<span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-pid="hOlPIXeY">AScript开源地址：<a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></p>

</div>
